text.p: Mall developer Ever-Gotesco Resources Holdings Inc on Tuesday reported an unaudited net income of 165 million pesos in 1996.
Gross revenues reached 562.4 million pesos, Corporate Secretary Vicente Canoneo told the Philippine Stock Exchange in a statement.
The comparative year-ago figures were not given.
The statement also said the company had decided to venture into the wholesale business.
Ever-Gotesco would sign several agreements with U.S.-based Price Ventures Inc to put up warehouse-type supermarkets in the country, it said.
Price Ventures is the owner of chain of warehouse stores in the United States.
The agreements will provide for licencing and technology transfer, training services, computer software, shareholders agreement and debenture purchase agreements.
Ever would use its subsidiary Pricesmart Trading Philippines Inc as the vehicle for the new business.
Canoneo also said the company would negotiate for a 500 million peso loan to partly finance the company's working capital and for the additional subscription of Pricesmart Trading shares.
